Question and Resource

[Focused question; named dataset/registry/specimen source; release/version; population and study period.]

Available Variables and Sample

[Review the actual dictionary and inclusion criteria. Specify exposure, outcome, essential covariates, analytic sample, and any unavailable variables.]

Access and Permissions

[Provider proposal, data/material agreements, permitted analyses, consent restrictions, and institutional review/determination still needed. Confirm access before promising the analysis.]

Feasibility and Resources

[Available sample/events, platform/software costs, skills, computing environment, specimen amount/quality when applicable, and timeline.]

Analysis Plan

[Define estimand, unit of analysis, weights/design if applicable, confounding, missing data, multiplicity, and sensitivity analyses. Justify precision/sample size using available data.]

Data/Specimen Protection

[Approved personnel, secure workspace, data transfer, storage, retention/destruction, and restrictions on linkage or redistribution.]

Interpretation and Submission

[Generalizability, selection and measurement limitations, and permissible conclusion. Use the current official LSU Health Data and Specimen Analysis template as directed.]
